title: Talent & Organizational Development Manager

description.summary:
Temer Properties is seeking a qualified Talent & Organizational Development Manager to lead talent acquisition, organizational development, culture, and employee experience initiatives. The role reports to the People & Culture Director.

Key Purpose: To attract, develop, and retain top talent while strengthening organizational capability, succession planning, and employee engagement to support Temer Properties’ growth and long-term success.
responsibilities: Lead recruitment, employer branding, and workforce planning.
Design and implement OD frameworks, job architecture, and change initiatives.
Drive culture, engagement, onboarding, and recognition programs.
Manage talent reviews, succession planning, and leadership pipeline development.
Deliver workforce insights and reporting to guide strategic decisions.
Qualifications: BA Degree in Management, Business Administration, or related field.
Minimum 5 years of experience in Talent Management, Organizational Development, or HR leadership.

requirements: Communication, stakeholder management, and execution discipline

title: Marketing & Brand Manager

description.summary:
MARKETING & BRAND MANAGER

Temer Properties is seeking a qualified Marketing & Brand Manager to lead brand strategy, marketing execution, and communication initiatives. The role reports to the Marketing Director.

Key Purpose Statement
To lead marketing, branding, promotion, and communication efforts that strengthen Temer Properties’ market presence, drive qualified leads, and enhance brand perception across digital and traditional platforms.

Competencies
• Strong STP, brand strategy, and analytical insight capabilities.
• Creative content development (digital & multimedia).
• Campaign planning, execution, and conversion optimization.
• Digital marketing expertise (Paid ads, analytics, social media etc).
• Strong communication, stakeholder management, and execution discipline.
responsibilities: Develop and implement overall marketing and brand strategy.
Lead market research and generate insights for business decisions.
Plan and execute integrated marketing campaigns across all channels.
Oversee content creation and creative production.
Drive digital marketing, media management, and brand reputation.
Qualifications: BA Degree in Marketing, Business Administration, Communication, or related fields.
Minimum 5 years of marketing experience, including leadership responsibilities, preferably in real estate or related sectors.
Proven ability in marketing & brand management, digital marketing, and lead generation.

requirements: Strong STP, brand strategy, and analytical insight capabilities

title: Copywriter

description.summary: We are seeking a skilled Senior IT Support & Systems Specialist to join our team. The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience supporting both office and field environments, strong troubleshooting abilities, and a passion for delivering reliable IT solutions. You will support daily operations, maintain systems, and provide end-user assistance across multiple locations.
responsibilities: Provide advanced technical support for computers, software, printers, and network devices.
Install, configure, and maintain IT equipment in office and field sites.
Troubleshoot hardware and software issues efficiently.
Support CRM, ERP, and internal digital systems.
Perform system updates, backups, and preventive maintenance.
Manage IT inventory and documentation.
Assist users with technical training and support.
Support wireless networks, routers, and access points.
Set up and support IT systems for temporary field operations and events.
Qualifications: Minimum 2 years of experience in IT support or a related role.
Strong troubleshooting skills and knowledge of operating systems.
Understanding of networking fundamentals and IT security basics.
Ability to handle both office and field technical support tasks.
Good communication and teamwork abilities.
Certifications in IT support or networking are a plus.

description.summary: We are looking for a Senior Network & Infrastructure Engineer with strong hands-on skills in structured cabling, networking, and equipment installation. This role covers both office-based and field-based network setup and maintenance.
responsibilities: Install and maintain network systems including routers, switches, and access points.
Deploy and manage structured cabling (UTP & fiber) in office and project sites.
Conduct network troubleshooting and performance checks.
Support CCTV and networked security systems connectivity.
Configure network devices and ensure secure connectivity.
Maintain documentation and inventory of network equipment.
Conduct on-site network setup for temporary and permanent workstations.
Monitor network stability and apply best-practice configurations.
Qualifications: Minimum 2 years of experience in network installation and support.
Strong understanding of LAN/WAN, IP addressing, and cabling standards.
Hands-on experience with fiber and copper cabling.
Ability to diagnose and fix network performance issues.
Ability to work in both office and site environments.
Certifications in networking are a plus.

title: Senior Surveillance & Security Systems Specialist

description.summary: We are seeking a Senior Surveillance & Security Systems Specialist skilled in CCTV, access control, and security system installation. The role includes installing and maintaining systems for both office and field environments.
responsibilities: Install and configure CCTV cameras, NVR/DVR systems, and monitoring tools.
Plan and install security-related cabling and power solutions.
Troubleshoot camera connectivity, video recording, and power issues.
Perform system inspections, maintenance, and reporting.
Set up remote viewing and monitoring systems.
Install and support access control and alarm systems.
Conduct site surveys and prepare installation plans.
Ensure all systems function efficiently and reliably.
Qualifications: Minimum 2 years of experience in CCTV and security systems setup.
Hands-on experience with IP cameras, DVR/NVR systems, and networking basics.
Understanding of cabling and power connectivity.
Strong problem-solving and technical ability.
Ability to support installations in both office and site environments.
Certifications in surveillance or security systems are a plus.

requirements: 2+ years of CCTV & Security System Experience

description.summary: We are seeking an experienced Real Estate Supervisor to join our dynamic team. The ideal candidate will have a passion for real estate, strong leadership skills, and a commitment to quality service. You will be responsible for overseeing the sales team, ensuring high-quality standards, and driving sales performance.
responsibilities: Supervise and lead a team of sales consultants.
Monitor and evaluate the performance of sales consultants to ensure targets are met.
Provide training and mentorship to enhance the skills of the sales team.
Maintain high standards of customer service and client satisfaction.
Develop and implement sales strategies to increase market share.
Analyze market trends and adjust strategies accordingly.
Prepare reports on sales performance and present to the Sales & Marketing Manager.
Qualifications: Bachelor's degree in Business, Real Estate, or related field preferred.
Minimum of 3 years of experience in real estate sales, with at least 1 year in a supervisory role.
Proven track record of achieving sales targets.
Excellent leadership and communication skills.
Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.

responsibilities: Assist clients in buying, selling, and renting properties.
Provide market analysis and property valuations.
Develop relationships with clients to understand their needs and preferences.
Conduct property showings and open houses.

Qualifications: Minimum of 1 year of experience in real estate sales or completed relevant training in real estate sales.
Strong interpersonal and communication skills.
Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
Knowledge of real estate regulations and practices.

description.summary: We are looking for a skilled Cameraman/Videographer to join our creative team. The ideal candidate will be responsible for capturing and producing high-quality photos and videos of properties, events, and marketing activities to support the company's brand and sales goals.
responsibilities: Capture photos and videos of properties, clients, and company events.
Operate cameras, lighting, drones, and audio equipment.

Qualifications: Proven hands-on experience in Film, Media, Photography, or related field preferred.
Proven experience as a Cameraman/Videographer (portfolio required).

Creativity, attention to detail, and ability to meet deadlines.
